name: Claude-Code-Crumbs
description: Claude Code plugins: dev-workflow for delivery pipelines, crumbs for small skills and configurations, analyze-run for timelines and retrospectives of agent runs.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Universal product-driven delivery workflow: TDD entry-point, subagent chain, zero-tolerance gates. Stack-, SoT-, and team-agnostic.

plugins.name: crumbs
plugins.description: A collection of small skills and configurations for Claude Code.

plugins.name: analyze-run
plugins.description: Rebuild how an agent run went from Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot transcripts: an interactive timeline of agents, skills and pivot events, with recommendations only where time was avoidable.
